'''Teranos''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Major/Legends|major]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], he posted a bounty offering rewards for retrieving stolen class-seven warheads from the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] led by [[Duran Gorr]].
